gloss_en: IFC4 export component ignores a custom base point and uses model origin, while the native Tekla export works.
title_original: IFC4 Export Component - Base Point Issue
question_paraphrase: exporting IFC4 via the Grasshopper component with a base point other than model origin still writes model origin; native export is fine; IFC2x3 component works
phrasing_notes: polite, short, compares working vs failing path
answer_summary: Maintainer shipped a fix release; reporter says it persists, suspects Base Point Export option (IfcMapConversion vs IfcSite coordinate system) not being passed.

gloss_en: Curved structural element from a Tekla IFC4 file gets wrong geometry in the viewer library.
title_original: Geometry problem with IFC from Tekla
question_paraphrase: geometry of a curved structure element in an IFC created in Tekla is generated wrongly; file attached
answer_summary: Open geometry-engine bug report with sample file; fix depends on the library's handling of the representation.

gloss_en: Some Tekla IFC models land in the wrong location in Blender but are correct in Navisworks.
title_original: BlenderBIM: Model imported to incorrect coordinates
question_paraphrase: some Tekla IFCs import to wrong coordinates in Blender though they federate fine in Navisworks; another Tekla model is fine
answer_summary: Placement/coordinate handling difference in the importer; reproducer supplied to developers.

gloss_en: IFC Toolbox crashes instantly when I drop an IFC exported from Tekla; Revit IFCs work.
title_original: Can't drop an IFC file created in Tekla
question_paraphrase: dropping a Tekla-made IFC crashes the tool; Revit IFCs are fine; only difference is the authoring tool
phrasing_notes: friendly greeting, thanks in advance, no version info

gloss_en: Opening a Tekla IFC in Revit gives in-place families with no data; linking duplicates assemblies and their sub-elements.
question_paraphrase: File>Open creates in-place families without IFC data and cannot map classes of assembly sub-elements; Link IFC imports assemblies plus parts (duplicate geometry)
context_given: Revit, IFC from Tekla with assemblies
phrasing_notes: asks for official feedback; compares two paths
answer_summary: Autodesk: Open and Link are separate code paths; plan to unify on the newer C# Link code supporting reference and design-transfer.

gloss_en: Linking an IFC directly vs the generated .ifc.rvt gives different project north; people share the .ifc.rvt to save load time.
title_original: PR: Different project north rotations depending on linking in IFC and corresponding .ifc.rvt file
question_paraphrase: linking IFC gives true-north alignment, linking .ifc.rvt gives project north; users cleaning very detailed Tekla IFCs with scripts before loading
answer_summary: Acknowledged as bug (Jira REVIT-248571); workaround: link the .ifc.rvt.

gloss_en: Tekla steel models wrap nearly everything in IfcElementAssembly, doubling element count; how should rebar relate to host elements?
title_original: Unclear how to relate reinforcing to the element
question_paraphrase: reinforcement-to-host relation is unclear; Tekla steel models group everything into IfcElementAssembly; doubles object count to 100k+
answer_summary: Discussion between aggregation under assembly vs a dedicated relationship; no consensus in thread.

gloss_en: Reference-model placement from an MCP tool ignores the model's 3D rotation, so a rotated IFC overlay is reported in the wrong place.
question_paraphrase: tool applies reference model Position but not Rotation3D; overlay inserted and rotated -90 deg reports ~9 m off; agent wrongly concluded model needed rotating
phrasing_notes: structured bug report with API property names
answer_summary: Rotation3D must be applied (and exposed) in placement output; Rotation reads 0 while axes encode the rotation.

gloss_en: Consolidated field requests from LLM-driven Tekla workflows: attribute audits, reference-model coordination, numbering status, typed UDA reads.
title_original: Consolidated remaining field requests from Tekla 2021/2023 workflows
question_paraphrase: index of gaps found when an AI agent drives Tekla: numeric UDA exported empty, batch readback only 20 of 200, numbering status tool, model-closed handling
answer_summary: Maintainer fixed several items in v0.9.0 (typed UDA, verification, numbering status).

gloss_en: Importing Tekla models into ETABS loses connectivity because coordinates with 10 decimals are rounded.
title_original: Models imported from Tekla affected by connectivity issues due to decimals tolerance
question_paraphrase: tolerance rounds 10-decimal coordinates so elements disconnect after import into ETABS
answer_summary: Tolerance handling needs change in toolkit.

gloss_en: Tekla connector in a web viewer shows duplicate overlapping instances and brace lines invisible.
question_paraphrase: overlapping duplicate instances, braces (lines in Tekla) not visible, some elements not highlighted on select
answer_summary: Duplicates came from the stream; line-based braces need viewer support.

gloss_en: Tool drops an entire structural grid when any axis has its own extents.
title_original: Tekla bake-scene drops structural grids with independent axis extents
question_paraphrase: grid with independent per-axis start/end is skipped as unsupported; bridge creates no Grid
answer_summary: Fixed in PR #424 using a shared rectangular envelope approximation.

gloss_en: Official: IFC2x3/IFC4/IFC4.3 export, views (reference, design transfer, bridge, precast), base point export via IfcMapConversion or IfcSite.
title_original: Tekla Structures IFC export overview and IFC4 export options
question_paraphrase: what export types exist and when to use Reference vs Design transfer view; how Location by base point works
answer_summary: Reference view for viewing; Design transfer view for handover; base point can be IfcMapConversion or IfcSite; 247-char path limit.

gloss_en: Official: verify an exported IFC by inserting it as reference model, comparing colors, clip planes and object counts.
question_paraphrase: insert exported IFC as reference model in the original model, compare counts, check export log, set failing objects to Brep
answer_summary: Visual comparison, object count check vs log, remodel or set IFC export type to Brep.

gloss_en: Official: property set configuration files, AdditionalPsets folder, filters by entity and object.
title_original: Modify property sets for IFC export
question_paraphrase: where property set config files live and how to add buildingSMART psets or filter psets to steel beams only
answer_summary: Files in AdditionalPsets under model folder or XS_FIRM/XS_PROJECT/XS_SYSTEM; each pset has name, entities, optional filter.

gloss_en: Official: assign IFC entity and subtype per part, None excludes object, UDA IFC export type Auto or B-rep.
title_original: IFC entity assignment in part properties (Export in IFC format)
question_paraphrase: how to set IFC entity/subtype/USERDEFINED per part and force B-rep for objects that fail export
answer_summary: IFC export section in part properties; None excludes (not for part cuts in surface geometry/precast); B-rep per object via UDA.

gloss_en: Official: IFC2x3 export types Surface geometry, Coordination view 2.0, Steel fabrication view, Coordination view 1.0 and what each does to rebar and voids.
title_original: IFC2x3 export types and advanced options
question_paraphrase: which export type to pick for viewing vs editing downstream vs fabrication; layer names, wide beams as plates, Organizer hierarchy
answer_summary: Surface geometry for viewing (B-rep); CV2.0 for editable geometry; Steel fabrication view keeps assembly presentation and bolt holes.

gloss_en: How many IfcElementAssembly and how many contain a single part
prompt: how many IfcElementAssembly in this tekla ifc, and how many have just one part inside?
expected_behavior: Count IfcElementAssembly, inspect IfcRelAggregates children per assembly, report totals and single-child count.

gloss_en: Check whether the file uses IfcMapConversion or IfcSite placement
prompt: did the base point export go via IfcMapConversion or IfcSite? need to know before linking into revit
expected_behavior: Look for IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS and IfcSite placement/RefLatitude; report which is present with values.

gloss_en: List all rebar elements and their hosts
prompt: list IfcReinforcingBar per host element, which wall/slab does each belong to? tekla precast export
expected_behavior: Traverse aggregation/assembly or relationships to find hosts; summarize counts per host; flag unattached bars.

gloss_en: Find objects exported as proxy
prompt: why so many IfcBuildingElementProxy in the tekla export? which parts and what class were they in tekla
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by name/ObjectType/Tekla Class property, suggest IFC entity assignment fixes.

gloss_en: Check property sets present on beams
prompt: what psets are on the beams? i expected Tekla Quantity and our UDAs
expected_behavior: List property sets/properties on IfcBeam, show which expected sets/UDAs are missing.

gloss_en: Compare placement of the structure and architecture IFCs
prompt: compare site placement and true north of struc IFC vs arch IFC, why 9 m off?
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite/IfcMapConversion, project north angle of both files, compute offset/rotation difference.

gloss_en: Compare two IFC exports and list changed parts
prompt: compare rev B and rev C ifc from tekla, whats added/removed/moved?
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId, report added, removed, changed placement/properties, caveat if GUIDs regenerated.

gloss_en: Total steel weight by profile
prompt: total weight of steel beams by profile name pls
expected_behavior: Group IfcBeam by profile, sum weight from quantity/pset, state source and units.

gloss_en: Find elements without geometry or with failed export
prompt: exported 4000 objects, import shows 3900. which ones have no representation?
expected_behavior: List elements lacking Representation, group by class, suggest B-rep setting on source.

gloss_en: Assign storeys from Tekla phase property
prompt: put elements into storeys based on the Phase property, all in one site/building now
expected_behavior: Create or reuse IfcBuildingStorey and reassign contained elements by property value; confirm before writing.

gloss_en: When to use Reference view vs Design transfer view
prompt: reference view or design transfer for sending to the architect to link in revit?
expected_behavior: Explain that Reference view is for viewing/linking, Design transfer for native conversion; recommend per use.

gloss_en: Revit duplicates geometry when linking Tekla assemblies
prompt: linked tekla ifc in revit and everything is doubled, assembly + parts. how to avoid?
expected_behavior: Explain assembly plus sub-parts import; suggest excluding single-part assemblies or mapping assembly class to deleted category.

gloss_en: Custom UDA not appearing in IFC
prompt: my UDA isnt in the ifc, numeric ones come out empty
expected_behavior: Check pset config contains the UDA, type mapping, suggest verifying in file; mention numeric UDA gaps.

gloss_en: Check bridge IFC4.3 export structure
prompt: bridge ifc4.3 from tekla - list IfcBridge parts and what elements are under each
expected_behavior: Traverse spatial hierarchy of IfcBridge/IfcBridgePart and list contained element classes and counts.
